title: distill expert functions into a Mirror view bank
hypothesis: A shared student MLP with one learned hidden-pair Givens coordinate per specialist can distill a family of view-related teacher experts at the quality of ordinary multi-head distillation using substantially fewer actual inference bytes; unrelated teachers will require private weights.
physical_object: One shared 12x16x4 student MLP, initialized from the Task-0 teacher and frozen except for method-specific adaptation state
mirror_coordinate: One learned float32 Givens angle per teacher/task, rotating the first two post-ReLU hidden activations before the shared output projection
logical_multiplicity: Five task-conditioned student predictors backed by one shared trunk/output weight and task ID
targeted_literature: Pruning and Distilling Mixture-of-Experts into Dense Language Models (arXiv:2605.28207)
Rethinking Self-Distillation for Multi-Teacher Capability Merging (arXiv:2610.04272)
Who Teaches Which Token? Verifier-Gated Multi-Expert On-Policy Distillation for Scientific Reasoning (arXiv:2609.15404)
PA09 multi-token prediction with shared trunk/future heads
teachers: Five teacher MLPs produce four-class soft targets for five task IDs. The common Task-0 teacher has hidden width 16. Aligned tasks are exactly the same MLP with one hidden-pair Givens view before the shared output projection. Independent tasks use separately sampled MLP weights. The task ID is provided to the student.
controls: frozen single shared student with no task state
one shared output head sequentially fine-tuned (ordinary single-student KD)
shared trunk with a private per-task output head (ordinary multi-head KD)
per-task rank-2 LoRA on the shared output projection
independent full student per teacher/task as upper control
teacher functions themselves as the quality/storage upper reference

distillation.objective: temperature-2 forward KL between teacher and student softmax logits, multiplied by T^2
distillation.selection_metric: mean held-out teacher/student KL at final stage across all methods and both teacher families, with accuracy and bytes as preregistered tie-breakers

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: packed tensor records charging every shared/student/private weight, Mirror angle, task ID, method, tensor name, dtype, shape, dimensions and header
storage.resume: torch.save inference state plus optimizer moments and step state, reported separately
paid_objects: all student shared weights and biases
all private output heads or LoRA factors

metrics: held-out forward KL to each teacher
student ECE against teacher argmax labels
actual total and incremental inference bytes
success_gate: On all three fresh aligned worlds, final Mirror mean teacher KL <=1.10x ordinary multi-head KD and <=1e-4 absolute, teacher/student top-1 agreement at least 0.99, ECE no more than 0.02 worse than multi-head, and actual total inference payload <=0.50x multi-head. Compare against rank-2 LoRA; if it matches at lower/equal bytes and compute, Mirror-specific advantage is not established.
failure_gate: Both development worlds miss either Mirror's KL/accuracy gate or <=0.50x multi-head total-inference-byte gate; keep fresh sealed.
boundaries: Aligned teachers are generated from the same view operation used by the candidate
Independent MLP teachers define the private-function boundary
Fixed 300-update distillation screen; no near-convergence capacity claim
No language-model, open-ended expert reasoning, or production ensemble claim

amendments.after: initial development screen, before any fresh seed access
amendments.reason: operational metric clarification only: clamp sub-precision negative KL estimates to zero; define final-stage inference throughput as 5 warm-up forwards then 50 timed forwards on a 2048-example batch with one CPU thread; do not change model, optimizer, updates, seeds, gates, or candidate selection rule
amendments.development_selection_result: learning_rate 0.003 selected by the registered mean held-out KL across methods, conditions, and development seeds
